turns.q: Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
turns.replyTail: Yes, we ship internationally through our localized websites. For many countries, taxes are included in the product price. However, additional customs duties may apply depending on your country and order value. These government charges are the customer’s responsibility and are outside MESHKI’s control. If taxes aren’t shown at checkout, please confirm the charges before placing your order.

turns.q: How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
turns.replyTail: Hi Maya! Standard shipping to the US is estimated at 4–9 business days. Shipping times are estimates, and orders aren’t processed on weekends or public holidays. For the most accurate estimate, enter your ZIP code on the product page or in your cart.

turns.q: Are any items final sale or non-returnable?
turns.replyTail:
Yes. For US orders, these items aren’t returnable:

Final Sale styles
Outlet items
Earrings and underwear accessories

Final Sale items may only be returned if MESHKI confirms they’re faulty. Other sale items can generally be returned for store credit if they meet the return conditions. Items must also be unworn, in original condition, with tags attached. Bodysuits and swimwear must have their hygiene stickers in place.
